gap_windows.summary: Base Staked ICNT PoolV2 contract address (0xAeD7C2eD...) and Sept 2025 audit report remained absent from public GLIF docs for 200.97 days until commit 7f14094d.

Instantaneous 0s UUPS proxy upgrade to 0x530a0cDd..., EIP-1967 proxy upgradeability, and controlling 3-of-6 Safe 0x5CC0FC29... remain undisclosed on icn.docs.glif.io and docs.glif.io after 405.29 days.

executive_risk_memo: Between June 2025 and November 2026, GLIF operated its Base Staked ICNT vault (0xAeD7C2eD7Bb84396AfCB55fF72c8F8E87FFb68f3) as an unprotected EIP-1967 UUPS proxy governed directly by a zero-timelock 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe (0x5CC0FC29C893Bba884D3E073997C97Bf776dA9F3) with no Safe Guard or Delay module. On October 10, 2025 (block 36,661,320), three Safe signers executed an instantaneous UUPS implementation upgrade from v1 (0xed236d2f...) to v2 (0x530a0cDd4E5f24A5BE77587146A05056c35edcEb) alongside companion Periphery proxy control. GLIF left Base Staked ICNT contracts and audits completely undocumented on GitHub and docs.glif.io for 200.97 days until commit 7f14094d launched icn.docs.glif.io on January 19, 2026 (block 41,034,590; repaired MTTR = 200.97 days). However, a 405.29-day disclosure gap remains open at finalized block 59,692,044: neither icn.docs.glif.io nor docs.glif.io discloses EIP-1967 upgradeability, implementation 0x530a0cDd..., 3-of-6 Safe 0x5CC0FC29..., or zero-delay upgrade/pause authority. Repository forensics in glifio/invariants show 2 Solidity and 12 Go commits by 1 engineer over 12 months (bus factor = 1), and Base PoolV2 source code remains unpublished (code_before_upgrade_verified = false) across GLIF's $15.64M protocol TVL ($0.80M on Base).

result.method: Batched JSON-RPC reads pinned to the block hash (EIP-1898); EIP-1967 / EIP-1822 / beacon proxies; capabilities from PUSH4 selectors in proxy + implementation bytecode (heuristic).
result.summary: Controlled by a 3-of-6 Safe with no timelock: changes can land instantly once signers agree. Capabilities seen in bytecode: pause, upgrade.

assessment.method: Live bytecode + storage heuristic at the pinned block, cross-checked with Pacta's RPC-pinned record for GLIF (block 59653624).
limits: riskScore (0-100) is a heuristic of the controller type and of pause / blacklist / upgrade capabilities read at one block; it is not an audit.

The live check reads EIP-1967 slots, owner(), Safe getThreshold() / getOwners() and TimelockController getMinDelay(); custom role systems, bridge or L2 admin paths and off-chain operations are not resolved.
Documentation is compared only for indexed protocols (catalogMatch), at their pinned block.

upgrade_x402.note: Free tier: 50 pre-flight calls per caller per UTC day (REST and MCP), then $0.01 per call over x402 (HTTP 402, never a dead-end 429). Paid routes below: POST the JSON body with an x402 X-PAYMENT (v1) or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) header.
